candidate.educational_objective: Teach parents to establish a dental home within 6 months of the first tooth and no later than age 12 months.

options.A: Schedule the first dental visit only after all primary teeth have erupted.
options.B: Wait until preschool unless pain, trauma, or visible decay occurs.
options.C: Establish a dental home within 6 months after the first tooth erupts and no later than 12 months of age.
options.D: Delay the first visit until the child can cooperate with a full examination, usually around age 3.

candidate.rationale: AAPD policy recommends establishing a dental home within 6 months after eruption of the first tooth and no later than 12 months of age. Early dental care supports prevention and age-appropriate risk assessment rather than waiting for symptoms or completion of the primary dentition.
candidate.source_claim_supported: AAPD recommends a dental home within 6 months of eruption of the first tooth and no later than 12 months of age.
